title: mettāsahagatena cetasā
titleEn: With a Mind Suffused with mettā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Come, bhikkhus, dwell pervading one quarter with a mind suffused with mettā, likewise the second quarter, the third quarter, and the fourth quarter.
Thus above, below, across, and everywhere,
and to all as to oneself, dwell pervading the entire world with a mind suffused with mettā, vast, exalted, boundless, without hostility, without ill-will.”
